Please see our Privacy Statement here.

Please note: publicjobs uses Oleeo as our recruitment platform provider. Oleeo is based in the United Kingdom, which means that some of your personal data will be processed in the UK. As the United Kingdom benefits from an adequacy decision under Article 45 of the GDPR, and in conjunction with the technical and organisational measures in place, personal data transferred to the UK continues to receive a level of protection equivalent to that provided within the EU. For further information on how and where publicjobs processes your personal data, please see our Privacy Statement.
